scope: Read-only G04 USDC-only/zero-ETH route diagnosis; no implementation, wallet signatures, transactions, credential discovery or service purchase.

requirements.read: Actual page text independently extracted with pdftotext. RC18-RC22 and G04-A01-A07 read.
requirements.interpretation: No app-funded fee sponsorship. A relayer may pay native gas up front and collect the exact user-approved capped USDC fee in the same successful funding transaction. Relayer is not prohibited. One onchain funding transaction is distinct from one signature prompt. Routine reversible component implementation does not require an owner waiver; measured wallet/route impossibility and changed UX/economic requirements do.

verifiedSourceChecks: EIP3009.sol _receiveWithAuthorization requires to==msg.sender, then validity/time/unspent authorization and signature, then consumes authorization and transfers.
EIP3009.sol uses SignatureChecker.isValidSignatureNow, including contract-account signature boundary.
deployedUsdcEvidence.limits: Explorer-linked verified implementation and ABI observed, not independent latest RPC storage/code verification or actual signed authorization execution. Upgradeable proxy must be rechecked at qualification. Saved snapshots bind observed evidence.

recommendation.primitive: Add an explicit USDC authorization entry to the existing aggregate funding router using USDC receiveWithAuthorization; preserve existing ETH entry owner check.
flow: User reviews complete allocations, all swap bounds, maximum USDC debit, exact relay reimbursement, chain/router/deadline and refund owner.

Use the EIP3009 nonce as a domain-separated hash of the exact full funding plan plus fresh salt; router recomputes and checks it. Alternatively a separate explicit complete-plan signature, never token-transfer authorization alone. The authorization payee is the fixed router; router is the USDC caller. Bind the submitter or exact fee recipient in the signed plan.

User signs EIP712 USDC receive authorization and the existing collateral depositFor consent; consent executor is router and beneficiary is user. Two signatures may still yield one initial onchain transaction. Do not request allowance or broad delegation.

Trusted relay journals exact signed plan and a single L1 transaction before submission. It supplies gas. Router atomically pulls exact USDC, performs bounded fixed-route conversions for ETH collateral and protocol FEE, deposits all three legs, refunds unused value to signed owner, and pays only the signed capped relay fee.

Any leg/reimbursement failure reverts all token/deposit/nonce state. Unknown transaction outcome remains unresolved and never authorizes resubmission; recover original hash/nonce and canonical all-leg receipt. Later Aztec claims reuse existing encrypted aggregate recovery.
recommendation.failureAccounting: An onchain reverted transaction still costs its native sender gas and cannot reimburse from reverted atomic state. Quote/estimate/policy must state this risk; do not describe intentionally subsidized successful routes as user-paid. Preflight before submitting and budget trusted test relay attempts under existing authority.
recommendation.noncustodial: No raw user key; no unrestricted allowance; no arbitrary calldata or recipient; no generated-code access to relayer credentials. Relay sees only public L1 authorizations, not private claim secrets; persist required user recovery material encrypted locally.

alternatives.permit: Actual deployed ABI supports permit, but approval alone cannot pay gas; it still needs a relayer and creates allowance state. receiveWithAuthorization is narrower for exact one-off transfer.
alternatives.walletBatching: Pinned MetaMask static capabilities and Sepolia batching support do not establish zero-native-gas funding.
alternatives.EIP7702: Delegation does not remove native gas payment; another sender/paymaster still must pay and be reimbursed. Not necessary for this signed-token route; never alter existing delegation merely to simplify testing.
alternatives.walletGasIncluded: Current MetaMask support lists no Sepolia gas-included network. Phantom gasless swap documentation does not qualify arbitrary funding sends.

qualificationBlockers: Fresh actual MetaMask and Phantom Ethereum-mode zero-ETH signing/canonical funding acceptance, including typed-data capability/version and all prompts. Phantom documentation index references EIP712 but actual installed extension capability not measured. No claim both named wallets already qualify.

Verify proxy current implementation/code/domain at a canonical block and execute a disposable exact authorization. EIP1271/7702 account signature compatibility must be measured, not presumed from an EOA signature.
A configured bounded trusted relay, fee quote and exact reimbursement policy are required. No paid external service has been selected or purchased by this review.

Current configured FEE conversion liquidity is not qualified. Historical 2026-10-11 read-only evidence found no direct FEE/WETH or FEE/USDC V2/V3 pools checked; positive historical WETH/USDC quotes do not solve this. Test issuance/faucet is not economic conversion. Fresh real quotes/runtime checks required before taking funds.

Current ETH-only router refuses relayer caller by beneficiary==msg.sender. Explicit authenticated USDC entry plus exact aggregate receipt/journal support is implementation work, not currently present qualification.
ownerBoundary: Implementation of the narrow local USDC/relay component is routine within G04. Owner decision is required only for a measured unsupported named-wallet/one-transaction alternative or changed economics/requirements; not merely because a relay is involved. Existing trusted test-ETH authorization governs test relay spending; no authority is inferred for new paid service contracts.
verdict: Supported authorization primitive verified in the configured token ABI/source; feasible bounded user-paid relay design. Full Sepolia route remains unqualified due wallet/relay/liquidity/receipt acceptance blockers. Not a proven impossible combination and not an owner-waiver prerequisite to reversible implementation.
